native_policies: All matrix/vector names share slots0..3; kind exists in reference header, not an independent vector bank.

Reset clears storage but preserves independently managed temporary_mask; begin_evaluation is separate.
Whole dimension word zero rejects a reference with status9 and preserves the output; nonzero partial dimension words are admitted, then rejected by consuming numerical leaves.
Early reference status is not inferred from final F9 records: complete171F4 preserves prior status0 across final1415A cleanup for partial dimensions.
Cell UI access accepts slots0..5 and upper bounds. Positive one-based coordinates1..3 are the explicit host prepared contract; native zero/invalid raw address arithmetic excluded.
Cell copy order is five descending16-bit words; partial overlaps are preserved by raw byte pointer access to prevent compiler struct-array non-overlap assumptions.
Full object and Ans copies include all inactive cells; same-shape dimension requests preserve all cells; shape changes clear all90 bytes.
Temporary construction preserves all reference metadata except low slot nibble; already-temporary references bypass allocation; exhausted allocation returns status7 without bank mutation.
